title: docs(skills): objects carry a colour from the nine-name palette; an object nav item draws its colour tile

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu9fyvLMxpnFDc8znm1Y6Esq)_

Part of #35985
Clause-②: no
No spec change and no export: the diff is skills text plus its changeset.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: this PR (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`)

## 维护者速读

- AI 和开发者读技能说明时，会看到对象有一个 `color` 属性：9 个颜色名（gray、blue、teal、green、amber、orange、red、pink、purple），不写就是灰色方块，并被要求「每个对象都给一个，同一应用里尽量不重复」。命令行 `os explain object` 列出颜色另开小卡 #36099。
- 这是对象颜色卡 #35985 的第 3 步：前两步已经把颜色加进对象定义、并换好了界面上所有对象图标。
- 只改说明文字，不动运行时行为，撤回即恢复。
- 还没闭环的一处：让 AI 新建应用时自动带上颜色，要 AI 服务把蓝图的 `color` 像 `icon` 一样传给对象，那部分代码不在本仓库（见下）。

## What changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | The object example carries `"color": "blue"`; the optional-properties table gains a `color` row: the nine names, `gray` as the default, no hex, the console draws `icon` white on it, "give every object one; avoid repeats in one app". |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` | One sentence after the keys-by-type list: an `object` item's icon sits on its object's `color` tile. Paid for in the same file by trimming two restatements (the run-modes lead-in, which the heading already says, and the "view authored for a one-off slice" aside, which the `filters` bullet already says). |
| `.changeset/35985-object-color-skills.md` | `@objectstack/skills` patch. |

The sentences are true of `main` 33d01694: the palette is `OBJECT_COLORS` in `packages/spec/src/data/object-icon.ts` (a non-palette value is refused by `z.enum`), an uncoloured object draws gray (`ObjectIconTile`), and an `object` navigation item draws `ObjectIconTile` with the item's `icon` (else the object's) and the object's colour (`ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` `resolveNavItemIcon` + `resolveTargetColor`); dashboards, pages and links keep the line icon.

## Open ends (named, not in this PR)

- **PR 1 L2 N7:** `os explain object` listing `color` (`packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts`) is its own card, #36099, so this PR stays skills-only.
- **PR 2 L2 N1, unchanged from before:** a coloured object with no `icon` draws no tile on four hosts: the record row on the record page and in the drawer, the grid pointer cell, and home recents. The skills text already asks for `icon` on every object (31/31 in the reference apps), so authored apps do not meet it.
- **AI service passthrough:** `BlueprintObjectSchema.color` shares the object's leaf (PR 1), but the step that turns a blueprint object into an object is not in this repository (no reader of `BlueprintObject*` outside `packages/spec`). The acceptance line "ask the AI for an app with three new objects, three colours" waits on the AI service passing `color` through as it does `icon`. The seat shuts the card by hand once the maintainer has seen this open end.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: 60 authored files within ceilings; `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 6703 / 6710, `objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` 2563 / 2564.
- `check-skill-links`, `check-skill-identifier-liveness`, `check-skill-top-level-keys`, `check-skill-frame-sync`, `check-skill-frame-freshness`, `check-skill-compatibility-version`: all OK.
- Skill descriptions are unchanged, so the `evals/triggers.json` routing is not touched.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36089` on head 788cf668: see the seat's record.
